mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trace_chain (trace_id, app_name, root_method, trace_json, total_ms, start_time) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{appName}, #{rootMethod}, #{traceJson}, #{totalMs}, #{startTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE root_method = VALUES(root_method), trace_json = VALUES(trace_json), total_ms = VALUES(total_ms), start_time = VALUES(start_time)
mapper.sql: id, trace_id, app_name, root_method, trace_json, total_ms, start_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trace_chain WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} LIMIT 1
